```plato
    // The trace: the sum of the diagonal entries.
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trace_(linear_algebra))
    DiagonalSum(self: SparseMatrix): Number
        => self.Entries.Reduce(0.0, (total, e) =>
            total + (e.IsDiagonal ? e.Value : 0.0));
```
